# Principles of data visualization; Simple data visualization in R 

https://utah.instructure.com/courses/1269209/files/206688825?wrap=1

## Usage
```r
# dot and line
plot()
# bar graphs
barplot()
# histograms
hist()
```

Plots to visualize data normality
```{r}
# to generate normal dist data
norm_data <- dnorm(1:100, 50, 10)
plot(norm_data)
```

To convert to lines instead of point.
```{r}
plot(norm_data, type = "l")
```

Barplots
```{r}
new_data <- dnorm(1:25, 12, 2.5)
barplot(new_data)
```

Histograms.
* Need to define intervals via breaks
    * Via range or vector
```{r}
class_birthmonth = c(10, 4, 2, 3, 10, 6, 2, 11, 7, 9, 9, 10, 3, 11, 10, 2, 2, 8, 5, 4, 2, 1, 3, 5,
3, 6, 6, 4, 10, 1, 11, 8, 10, 6, 12, 8, 2, 3, 12, 5, 4, 8, 1, 8, 2, 1, 7, 9, 7, 6, 4, 12, 9, 10, 5,
2, 2, 2, 12, 5, 11, 12, 4, 10, 4, 2, 6)
hist(class_birthmonth, breaks=0:12)
```
